WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    totals.transactions,
    device.deviceCategory
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
),
visitors_with_transactions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM sessions
  WHERE transactions IS NOT NULL
),
first_visit AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    MIN(s.date) AS first_visit_date
  FROM sessions s
  WHERE s.fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM visitors_with_transactions)
  GROUP BY s.fullVisitorId
),
first_transaction AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    s.date AS first_transaction_date,
    s.deviceCategory,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.fullVisitorId ORDER BY s.date) as rn
  FROM sessions s
  WHERE s.transactions IS NOT NULL
    AND s.fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM visitors_with_transactions)
)
SELECT 
  fv.fullVisitorId,
  fv.first_visit_date,
  ft.first_transaction_date,
  ft.deviceCategory,
  DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ft.first_transaction_date), 
            PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fv.first_visit_date), DAY) AS days_elapsed
FROM first_visit fv
JOIN first_transaction ft ON fv.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId
WHERE ft.rn = 1
ORDER BY fullVisitorId

WITH top_source AS (
  SELECT 
    t.trafficSource.source as traffic_source
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` t
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(t.hits) AS h
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY traffic_source
  ORDER BY SUM(p.productRevenue) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
daily_revs AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(daily_rev) as max_daily
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 / 1000000.0 as daily_rev
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` t
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(t.hits) AS h
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
      AND t.trafficSource.source = (SELECT traffic_source FROM top_source)
      AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.date
  )
),
weekly_revs AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(weekly_rev) as max_weekly
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 / 1000000.0 as weekly_rev
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` t
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(t.hits) AS h
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
      AND t.trafficSource.source = (SELECT traffic_source FROM top_source)
      AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', t.date), WEEK(MONDAY))
  )
),
monthly_revs AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(monthly_rev) as max_monthly
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 / 1000000.0 as monthly_rev
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` t
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(t.hits) AS h
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
      AND t.trafficSource.source = (SELECT traffic_source FROM top_source)
      AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', t.date), MONTH)
  )
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT traffic_source FROM top_source) as traffic_source,
  ROUND(max_daily, 6) as max_daily_product_revenue_millions,
  ROUND(max_weekly, 6) as max_weekly_product_revenue_millions,
  ROUND(max_monthly, 6) as max_monthly_product_revenue_millions
FROM daily_revs, weekly_revs, monthly_revs

SELECT 
  session_month,
  session_type,
  ROUND(AVG(pageviews), 2) AS avg_pageviews
FROM (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    totals.pageviews,
    totals.transactions,
    CASE 
      WHEN totals.transactions >= 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) h, UNNEST(h.product) p WHERE p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL) THEN 'purchase'
      WHEN totals.transactions IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) h, UNNEST(h.product) p WHERE p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL) THEN 'non-purchase'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS session_type,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS session_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
)
WHERE session_type IN ('purchase', 'non-purchase')
GROUP BY session_month, session_type
ORDER BY session_month, session_type

-- Final query: Get the top product by total quantity purchased by YouTube buyers (excluding YouTube products)
WITH youtube_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` as s,
    UNNEST(s.hits) as h
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) as p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND p.v2ProductCategory = 'Home/Shop by Brand/YouTube/'
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
)
SELECT 
  p.v2ProductName as product_name,
  SUM(p.productQuantity) as total_quantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` as s,
  UNNEST(s.hits) as h
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) as p
JOIN youtube_buyers yb ON s.fullVisitorId = yb.fullVisitorId
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND p.productQuantity > 0
  AND p.v2ProductName NOT LIKE '%YouTube%'
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH daily_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_incidents.incidents_2016`
  WHERE descript = 'PUBLIC INTOXICATION'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2016
  GROUP BY date
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(cnt) as mean_cnt,
    STDDEV(cnt) as stddev_cnt
  FROM daily_counts
),
z_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    d.date,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(d.cnt - s.mean_cnt, s.stddev_cnt) as z_score
  FROM daily_counts d
  CROSS JOIN stats s
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', date) as date
FROM z_scores
ORDER BY z_score DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    visitStartTime,
    h.hitNumber,
    h.time,
    h.type,
    h.page.pagePath,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY h.hitNumber) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
  AND trafficSource.campaign LIKE '%Data Share%'
  AND h.type = 'PAGE'
),
home_hits AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM sessions
  WHERE pagePath LIKE '/home%'
),
next_pages AS (
  SELECT 
    hh.fullVisitorId,
    hh.visitId,
    hh.pagePath AS homePage,
    hh.time AS homeTime,
    hh.hitNumber AS homeHitNumber,
    np.pagePath AS nextPage,
    np.time AS nextTime,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(np.time - hh.time AS INT64), 1000) AS timeOnHomeSeconds
  FROM home_hits hh
  LEFT JOIN sessions np 
    ON hh.fullVisitorId = np.fullVisitorId 
    AND hh.visitId = np.visitId 
    AND np.rn = hh.rn + 1
),
most_common_next AS (
  SELECT nextPage
  FROM next_pages
  WHERE nextPage IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY nextPage
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
max_time AS (
  SELECT CAST(MAX(timeOnHomeSeconds) AS INT64) AS max_time_seconds
  FROM next_pages
  WHERE nextPage IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  mcn.nextPage AS most_common_next_page,
  mt.max_time_seconds AS max_time_on_home_seconds
FROM most_common_next mcn
CROSS JOIN max_time mt

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) / 1000000 AS monthly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
  '(direct)' AS traffic_source,
  ROUND(MAX(monthly_revenue_millions) - MIN(monthly_revenue_millions), 2) AS difference_millions
FROM monthly_revenue

WITH qualifying_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*`, 
  UNNEST(hits) AS h, UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE p.v2ProductName = 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
  AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
)
SELECT p.v2ProductName, SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_quantity_sold
FROM qualifying_customers qc
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` g
  ON qc.fullVisitorId = g.fullVisitorId
, UNNEST(g.hits) AS h
, UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE p.v2ProductName != 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH users_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
      WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    )
),
users_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
      WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as distinct_pseudo_users
FROM users_7day u7
WHERE u7.user_pseudo_id NOT IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM users_2day)

WITH us_daily AS (
  SELECT date, new_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE country_name = 'United States of America' 
    AND aggregation_level = 0
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) IN (3, 4)
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    new_confirmed,
    LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prev_new_confirmed
  FROM us_daily
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d', date) AS mm_dd,
  date,
  new_confirmed,
  prev_new_confirmed,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed - prev_new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed) AS growth_rate
FROM with_prev
WHERE prev_new_confirmed IS NOT NULL AND prev_new_confirmed > 0
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT provider_city,
       SUM(total_discharges) AS total_discharges,
       SUM(average_total_payments * total_discharges) / SUM(total_discharges) AS weighted_avg_total_payment
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
WHERE drg_definition = '470 - MAJOR JOINT REPLACEMENT OR REATTACHMENT OF LOWER EXTREMITY W/O MCC'
GROUP BY provider_city
ORDER BY total_discharges DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH top_20_bike_routes AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_name,
        end_station_name,
        ROUND(start_station_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
        ROUND(start_station_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
        ROUND(end_station_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
        ROUND(end_station_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
        COUNT(*) as trip_count,
        AVG(tripduration) as avg_bike_duration
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
        AND tripduration > 0
    GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name, start_station_latitude, start_station_longitude, end_station_latitude, end_station_longitude
    ORDER BY trip_count DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
taxi_durations AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
        ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
        ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
        ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
        AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND)) as avg_taxi_duration
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
    WHERE dropoff_datetime IS NOT NULL 
        AND pickup_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) > 0
        AND pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL AND pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
        AND dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL AND dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY start_lat, start_lon, end_lat, end_lon
),
faster_routes AS (
    SELECT 
        br.start_station_name,
        br.end_station_name,
        br.trip_count,
        br.avg_bike_duration,
        td.avg_taxi_duration
    FROM top_20_bike_routes br
    JOIN taxi_durations td 
        ON br.start_lat = td.start_lat 
        AND br.start_lon = td.start_lon
        AND br.end_lat = td.end_lat
        AND br.end_lon = td.end_lon
    WHERE br.avg_bike_duration < td.avg_taxi_duration
)
SELECT 
    start_station_name,
    end_station_name,
    ROUND(avg_bike_duration, 2) as avg_bike_duration
FROM faster_routes
ORDER BY avg_bike_duration DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT
    trip_seconds,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(trip_seconds, 60.0) AS trip_minutes,
    fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600
),
with_quantile AS (
  SELECT
    trip_minutes,
    fare,
    NTILE(6) OVER (ORDER BY trip_minutes) AS quantile_group
  FROM filtered_trips
)
SELECT
  quantile_group,
  ROUND(MIN(trip_minutes)) AS min_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(MAX(trip_minutes)) AS max_duration_minutes,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
  AVG(fare) AS avg_fare
FROM with_quantile
GROUP BY quantile_group
ORDER BY quantile_group

WITH kings_tracts AS (
    SELECT geo_id, median_income 
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr`
    WHERE geo_id LIKE '36047%'
),
tract_zips AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cw.census_tract_geoid, cw.zip_code
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.hud_zipcode_crosswalk.zipcode_to_census_tracts` cw
    WHERE cw.census_tract_geoid LIKE '36047%'
),
donations AS (
    SELECT 
        tz.census_tract_geoid,
        AVG(i.transaction_amt) as avg_donation
    FROM tract_zips tz
    INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fec.indiv20` i
        ON tz.zip_code = i.zip_code
    WHERE i.state = 'NY'
    GROUP BY tz.census_tract_geoid
)
SELECT 
    k.geo_id as census_tract,
    ROUND(d.avg_donation, 2) as avg_donation_amount,
    k.median_income
FROM kings_tracts k
LEFT JOIN donations d ON k.geo_id = d.census_tract_geoid
ORDER BY k.geo_id

WITH condition_acres AS (
    SELECT 
        p.evaluation_group,
        p.evaluation_group_description,
        p.evaluation_type,
        p.evaluation_description,
        p.state_code,
        c.condition_status_code,
        SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0) * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot, 0)) as subplot_acres,
        SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0) * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, 0)) as macroplot_acres
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
        ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
        AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
        AND c.state_code = p.state_code
    WHERE c.inventory_year = 2012
      AND CAST(p.evaluation_group AS STRING) LIKE '%2012'
    GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, p.state_code, c.condition_status_code
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT 
        evaluation_group,
        evaluation_group_description,
        evaluation_description,
        state_code,
        condition_status_code,
        SUM(subplot_acres) as total_subplot_acres,
        SUM(macroplot_acres) as total_macroplot_acres
    FROM condition_acres
    GROUP BY evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description, evaluation_description, state_code, condition_status_code
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC) as rn
    FROM grouped
),
top_conditions AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
eval_type_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.evaluation_group,
        ca.evaluation_type,
        ca.condition_status_code,
        ca.subplot_acres,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.evaluation_group, ca.condition_status_code ORDER BY ca.subplot_acres DESC) as type_rn
    FROM condition_acres ca
    INNER JOIN top_conditions tc 
        ON ca.evaluation_group = tc.evaluation_group 
        AND ca.condition_status_code = tc.condition_status_code
)
SELECT 
    tc.evaluation_group,
    tc.evaluation_group_description as evaluation_group_name,
    etr.evaluation_type,
    tc.condition_status_code,
    tc.evaluation_description,
    tc.state_code,
    tc.total_macroplot_acres as macroplot_acres,
    tc.total_subplot_acres as subplot_acres
FROM top_conditions tc
LEFT JOIN eval_type_ranked etr 
    ON tc.evaluation_group = etr.evaluation_group 
    AND tc.condition_status_code = etr.condition_status_code
    AND etr.type_rn = 1
ORDER BY tc.total_subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH under20 AS (
  SELECT 
    country_name,
    SUM(population) AS pop_under_20
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific`
  WHERE year = 2020 AND age BETWEEN 0 AND 19
  GROUP BY country_name
),
total_pop AS (
  SELECT 
    country_name,
    midyear_population
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population`
  WHERE year = 2020
)
SELECT 
  u.country_name,
  u.pop_under_20,
  t.midyear_population,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(u.pop_under_20, t.midyear_population) * 100 AS pct_under_20
FROM under20 u
JOIN total_pop t ON u.country_name = t.country_name
ORDER BY pct_under_20 DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT country_name, 
       cumulative_confirmed, 
       cumulative_recovered,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cumulative_recovered, cumulative_confirmed) * 100, 2) as recovery_rate_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
WHERE date = '2020-05-10' AND aggregation_level = 0 
  AND cumulative_confirmed > 50000
  AND cumulative_recovered IS NOT NULL
  AND cumulative_recovered <= cumulative_confirmed
ORDER BY recovery_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)) AS date,
    SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) AS temp_f,
    SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) AS prcp_in,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) AS wdsp_knots
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290' AND year = '2019' AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
),
converted AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    ROUND((temp_f - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0, 1) AS temp_c,
    ROUND(prcp_in * 2.54, 1) AS prcp_cm,
    ROUND(wdsp_knots * 0.514444, 1) AS wind_ms
  FROM base_data
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wind_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS prcp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wind_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS wind_ma8
  FROM converted
)
SELECT 
  date,
  temp_c,
  prcp_cm,
  wind_ms,
  temp_ma8,
  prcp_ma8,
  wind_ma8,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_lag1,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_lag1,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_ma_lag1,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_lag2,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_lag2,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_ma_lag2,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_lag3,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_lag3,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_ma_lag3,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_lag4,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_lag4,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_ma_lag4,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_lag5,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_lag5,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_ma_lag5,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_lag6,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_lag6,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_ma_lag6,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_lag7,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_lag7,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_ma_lag7,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_lag8,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_lag8,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_ma_lag8
FROM with_ma
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date
LIMIT 20

WITH hurricane_sids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sid, name 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`

),
storm_tracks AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` h
  INNER JOIN hurricane_sids hs ON h.sid = hs.sid
  WHERE h.season = '2020' AND h.basin = 'NA'
),
consecutive_distances AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    iso_time,
    pt,
    ST_DISTANCE(pt, LEAD(pt) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time)) AS dist_to_next
  FROM storm_tracks

storm_distances AS (
  SELECT

),
second_hurricane AS (

)
SELECT latitude 
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` h
INNER JOIN second_hurricane sh ON h.sid = sh.sid
WHERE h.season = '2020' AND h.basin = 'NA'
ORDER BY h.iso_time DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH stations_with_distance AS (
  SELECT
    s.id,
    s.name,
    s.latitude,
    s.longitude,
    -- Haversine distance in km using a constant for PI
    6371 * ACOS(
      COS(41.8319 * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * COS(s.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) *
      COS(s.longitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180 - (-87.6847) * 3.14159265358979 / 180) +
      SIN(41.8319 * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * SIN(s.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180)
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_stations` s
)
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  ROUND(distance_km, 2) AS distance_km
FROM stations_with_distance
WHERE distance_km <= 50
ORDER BY distance_km

WITH same_station_trips AS (

    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`

group_windows AS (

group_trips AS (

)

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    tz.borough as pickup_borough,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.tip_amount = 0 THEN 'no tip'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 5 THEN 'Less than 5%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 > 5 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 10 THEN '5% to 10%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 > 10 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 15 THEN '10% to 15%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 > 15 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 20 THEN '15% to 20%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 > 20 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 25 THEN '20% to 25%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 > 25 THEN 'More than 25%'
    END as tip_category
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
    ON t.pickup_location_id = tz.zone_id
  WHERE t.data_file_month = 1
    AND DATE(t.pickup_datetime) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-07'
    AND t.passenger_count > 0
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
    AND t.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t.total_amount >= 0
    AND tz.borough NOT IN ('EWR', 'Staten Island')
),
category_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    tip_category,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM filtered_trips
  GROUP BY pickup_borough, tip_category
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    SUM(trip_count) as total_trips
  FROM category_counts
  GROUP BY pickup_borough
)
SELECT 
  cc.pickup_borough,
  cc.tip_category,
  cc.trip_count,
  tc.total_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(cc.trip_count, tc.total_trips) as proportion
FROM category_counts cc
JOIN total_counts tc ON cc.pickup_borough = tc.pickup_borough
ORDER BY cc.pickup_borough, 
  CASE cc.tip_category
    WHEN 'no tip' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Less than 5%' THEN 2
    WHEN '5% to 10%' THEN 3
    WHEN '10% to 15%' THEN 4
    WHEN '15% to 20%' THEN 5
    WHEN '20% to 25%' THEN 6
    WHEN 'More than 25%' THEN 7
  END

user_activity AS (

    u.id as user_id,

    fa.first_answer_date,
    CASE WHEN fq.first_question_date IS NOT NULL 
         AND fq.first_question_date <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(u.creation_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as asked_within_30_days,
    CASE WHEN fq.first_question_date IS NOT NULL 
         AND fq.first_question_date <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(u.creation_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)

         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as answered_after_first_q_within_30

  LEFT JOIN first_answers fa ON u.id = fa.user_id

  SUM(answered_after_first_q_within_30) as users_answered_after_first_within_30,

WITH complaint_types AS (
  SELECT complaint_type
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2008-01-01' AND created_date < '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY complaint_type
),
temp_data AS (
  SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as date, AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9 AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2008' AND '2017'
  GROUP BY year, mo, da
),
daily_complaints AS (
  SELECT DATE(created_date) as date, complaint_type, COUNT(*) as complaint_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2008-01-01' AND created_date < '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date), complaint_type
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT DATE(created_date) as date, COUNT(*) as total_complaints
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2008-01-01' AND created_date < '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date)
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    t.date,
    t.avg_temp,
    ct.complaint_type,
    COALESCE(dc.complaint_count, 0) as complaint_count,
    dt.total_complaints,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(dc.complaint_count, 0), dt.total_complaints) as pct_complaints
  FROM temp_data t
  JOIN complaint_types ct ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN daily_complaints dc ON t.date = dc.date AND ct.complaint_type = dc.complaint_type
  LEFT JOIN daily_totals dt ON t.date = dt.date
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    SUM(complaint_count) as total_complaints,
    COUNT(*) as days_with_temp,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(*) * SUM(avg_temp * complaint_count) - SUM(avg_temp) * SUM(complaint_count),
      SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(avg_temp * avg_temp) - POWER(SUM(avg_temp), 2)) * 
           (COUNT(*) * SUM(complaint_count * complaint_count) - POWER(SUM(complaint_count), 2)))
    ) as pearson_r_temp_count,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(*) * SUM(avg_temp * pct_complaints) - SUM(avg_temp) * SUM(pct_complaints),
      SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(avg_temp * avg_temp) - POWER(SUM(avg_temp), 2)) * 
           (COUNT(*) * SUM(pct_complaints * pct_complaints) - POWER(SUM(pct_complaints), 2)))
    ) as pearson_r_temp_pct
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING SUM(complaint_count) > 5000
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  total_complaints,
  days_with_temp,
  ROUND(pearson_r_temp_count, 4) as pearson_r_temp_count,
  ROUND(pearson_r_temp_pct, 4) as pearson_r_temp_pct
FROM stats
WHERE ABS(pearson_r_temp_count) > 0.5
ORDER BY ABS(pearson_r_temp_count) DESC

WITH daily_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
    COUNT(*) as total_complaints
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2011-01-01' AND created_date < '2021-01-01'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date)
),
daily_type_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as type_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2011-01-01' AND created_date < '2021-01-01'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date), complaint_type
),
total_by_type AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, SUM(type_count) as total_count
  FROM daily_type_counts
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING SUM(type_count) > 3000
),
daily_proportions AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(dt2.complaint_date AS STRING) as complaint_date,
    t2.complaint_type,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(t2.type_count, dt2.total_complaints) as proportion
  FROM daily_type_counts t2
  JOIN daily_totals dt2 ON t2.complaint_date = dt2.complaint_date
  WHERE t2.complaint_type IN (SELECT complaint_type FROM total_by_type)
),
wind_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CONCAT(year, '-', LPAD(mo, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(da, 2, '0')) as wind_date,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE stn = '744860' 
    AND wban = '94789'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
    AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL 
    AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
),
correlations AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.complaint_type,
    CORR(dp.proportion, wd.wind_speed) as pearson_corr
  FROM daily_proportions dp
  JOIN wind_data wd ON dp.complaint_date = wd.wind_date
  GROUP BY dp.complaint_type
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    ROUND(pearson_corr, 4) as pearson_corr,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pearson_corr DESC) as rn_pos,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pearson_corr ASC) as rn_neg
  FROM correlations
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  pearson_corr
FROM ranked
WHERE rn_pos = 1 OR rn_neg = 1

WITH alive_1995 AS (

WITH y1995_base AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) as latin,
    spc_common,
    status,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), spc_common, status
),
y1995_common_ranked AS (
  SELECT latin, spc_common, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY latin ORDER BY SUM(cnt) DESC) as rn
  FROM y1995_base
  GROUP BY latin, spc_common
),
y1995_common AS (
  SELECT latin, spc_common FROM y1995_common_ranked WHERE rn = 1
),
y1995_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    b.latin,
    c.spc_common as common_name,
    SUM(b.cnt) as total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Fair', 'Critical', 'Poor') THEN b.cnt ELSE 0 END) as alive_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'Dead' THEN b.cnt ELSE 0 END) as dead_count
  FROM y1995_base b
  JOIN y1995_common c ON b.latin = c.latin
  GROUP BY b.latin, c.spc_common
),
y2015_base AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) as latin,
    spc_common,
    status,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), spc_common, status
),
y2015_common_ranked AS (
  SELECT latin, spc_common, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY latin ORDER BY SUM(cnt) DESC) as rn
  FROM y2015_base
  GROUP BY latin, spc_common
),
y2015_common AS (
  SELECT latin, spc_common FROM y2015_common_ranked WHERE rn = 1
),
y2015_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    b.latin,
    c.spc_common as common_name,
    SUM(b.cnt) as total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'Alive' THEN b.cnt ELSE 0 END) as alive_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'Dead' THEN b.cnt ELSE 0 END) as dead_count
  FROM y2015_base b
  JOIN y2015_common c ON b.latin = c.latin
  GROUP BY b.latin, c.spc_common
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(a.latin, b.latin) as latin,
    COALESCE(a.common_name, b.common_name) as common_name,
    COALESCE(a.total_count, 0) as total_1995,
    COALESCE(b.total_count, 0) as total_2015,
    COALESCE(a.alive_count, 0) as alive_1995,
    COALESCE(b.alive_count, 0) as alive_2015,
    COALESCE(a.dead_count, 0) as dead_1995,
    COALESCE(b.dead_count, 0) as dead_2015
  FROM y1995_agg a
  FULL OUTER JOIN y2015_agg b ON a.latin = b.latin
  WHERE COALESCE(a.total_count, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(b.total_count, 0) > 0
)
SELECT 
  latin,
  common_name,
  total_1995,
  total_2015,
  alive_1995,
  alive_2015,
  dead_1995,
  dead_2015,
  total_2015 - total_1995 as total_growth,
  alive_2015 - alive_1995 as alive_growth,
  dead_2015 - dead_1995 as dead_growth
FROM joined
ORDER BY total_growth DESC
LIMIT 10

),
zip_codes_wa AS (

),
point_geom AS (

),
target_zips AS (
  SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom
  FROM zip_codes_wa, point_geom
  WHERE ST_DISTANCE(zip_code_geom, pt) < 5 * 1609.34
),
tract_zip_overlap AS (
  SELECT 
    w.geo_id,
    a.total_pop,
    a.income_per_capita,
    t.zip_code,
    ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(w.tract_geom, t.zip_code_geom)) AS overlap_area,

  WHERE ST_AREA(w.tract_geom) > 0
)

  zip_code,

WITH morbidity AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) as year,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS as county_fips,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as births_no_morbidity,
    SUM(Births) as total_births
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) BETWEEN 2016 AND 2018
  GROUP BY year, County_of_Residence_FIPS
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2016 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2017 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
combined AS (
  SELECT m.year, m.county_fips, 
         SAFE_DIVIDE(m.births_no_morbidity, m.total_births) * 100 as pct_no_morbidity,
         CASE m.year 
           WHEN 2016 THEN c2015.poverty_rate
           WHEN 2017 THEN c2016.poverty_rate
           WHEN 2018 THEN c2017.poverty_rate
         END as poverty_rate
  FROM morbidity m
  LEFT JOIN census_2015 c2015 ON m.county_fips = c2015.geo_id AND m.year = 2016
  LEFT JOIN census_2016 c2016 ON m.county_fips = c2016.geo_id AND m.year = 2017
  LEFT JOIN census_2017 c2017 ON m.county_fips = c2017.geo_id AND m.year = 2018
  WHERE c2015.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL 
     OR c2016.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL 
     OR c2017.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT year, county_fips, pct_no_morbidity, poverty_rate
  FROM combined
  WHERE poverty_rate IS NOT NULL AND pct_no_morbidity IS NOT NULL
),
corr AS (
  SELECT year,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(poverty_rate) as sum_x,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y,
    SUM(poverty_rate * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_xy,
    SUM(poverty_rate * poverty_rate) as sum_x2,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y2
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT year,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y,
    SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y))
  ) as pearson_correlation
FROM corr
ORDER BY year

WITH latest_eval AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group_sequence_number, evaluation_group,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state_code ORDER BY evaluation_group DESC) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population`
  WHERE evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
  GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group_sequence_number, evaluation_group
),
latest_eval_filtered AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group_sequence_number, evaluation_group
  FROM latest_eval
  WHERE rn = 1
),
pop_cond AS (
  SELECT 
    p.state_code,
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.expansion_factor,
    p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot,
    p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot,
    c.condition_status_code,
    c.reserved_status_code,
    c.site_productivity_class_code,
    c.proportion_basis,
    c.condition_proportion_unadjusted
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c 
    ON p.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
    AND p.state_code = c.state_code
  JOIN latest_eval_filtered lef
    ON p.evaluation_group_sequence_number = lef.evaluation_group_sequence_number
    AND p.state_code = lef.state_code
  WHERE p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
    AND (
      (c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0)
      OR (c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0)
    )
),
state_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    state_code,
    evaluation_group,
    SUM(CASE 
      WHEN condition_status_code = 1 
           AND COALESCE(reserved_status_code, -1) = 0 
           AND site_productivity_class_code BETWEEN 1 AND 6
      THEN expansion_factor * condition_proportion_unadjusted 
           * CASE 
               WHEN proportion_basis = 'MACR' THEN adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
               WHEN proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
               ELSE 0
             END
      ELSE 0 
    END) as timberland_acres,
    SUM(CASE 
      WHEN condition_status_code = 1
      THEN expansion_factor * condition_proportion_unadjusted 
           * CASE 
               WHEN proportion_basis = 'MACR' THEN adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
               WHEN proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
               ELSE 0
             END
      ELSE 0 
    END) as forestland_acres
  FROM pop_cond
  GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group
),
timberland_max AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, timberland_acres as total_acres
  FROM state_acres
  ORDER BY timberland_acres DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
forestland_max AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, forestland_acres as total_acres
  FROM state_acres
  ORDER BY forestland_acres DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
state_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT state_code, state_code_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition`
)
SELECT t.state_code, t.evaluation_group, sn.state_code_name, t.total_acres as timberland_acres, NULL as forestland_acres
FROM timberland_max t
JOIN state_names sn ON t.state_code = sn.state_code
UNION ALL
SELECT f.state_code, f.evaluation_group, sn.state_code_name, NULL as timberland_acres, f.total_acres as forestland_acres
FROM forestland_max f
JOIN state_names sn ON f.state_code = sn.state_code

-- Compute correlation between gain and loss frequencies per cytoband for each chromosome
-- Using RecurrentNumData which already has Morph and Topo filters
-- But RecurrentNumData doesn't have cytoband-level data, only chromosome-level

-- Let me try a different approach: compute correlation between gain and loss frequencies
-- across chromosomes for morph=3111, topo=0401
WITH breast_freq AS (
  SELECT 
    Chromosome,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Abnormality LIKE '+%' THEN CAST(TotalCases AS INT64) ELSE 0 END) as gain_freq,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Abnormality LIKE '-%' THEN CAST(TotalCases AS INT64) ELSE 0 END) as loss_freq
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.RecurrentNumData`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401'
  GROUP BY Chromosome
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as n,
  SUM(gain_freq) as sum_gain,
  SUM(loss_freq) as sum_loss,
  SUM(gain_freq * loss_freq) as sum_gl,
  SUM(gain_freq * gain_freq) as sum_gain2,
  SUM(loss_freq * loss_freq) as sum_loss2,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(*) * SUM(gain_freq * loss_freq) - SUM(gain_freq) * SUM(loss_freq),
    SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(gain_freq * gain_freq) - SUM(gain_freq) * SUM(gain_freq)) * 
         (COUNT(*) * SUM(loss_freq * loss_freq) - SUM(loss_freq) * SUM(loss_freq)))
  ) as pearson_corr_gain_loss
FROM breast_freq
WHERE gain_freq > 0 OR loss_freq > 0

WITH proteome_agg AS (
  SELECT p.gene_symbol, a.sample_submitter_id, a.sample_type, AVG(p.protein_abundance_log2ratio) as avg_protein_log2ratio
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.quant_proteome_CPTAC_CCRCC_discovery_study_pdc_current` p
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.PDC_metadata.aliquot_to_case_mapping_current` a 
    ON p.aliquot_id = a.aliquot_id
  WHERE a.sample_type IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
    AND p.protein_abundance_log2ratio IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.gene_symbol, a.sample_submitter_id, a.sample_type
),
rna_agg AS (
  SELECT sample_barcode, gene_name, sample_type_name, AVG(fpkm_unstranded) as avg_fpkm
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.RNAseq_hg38_gdc_current`
  WHERE primary_site = 'Kidney' 
    AND sample_type_name IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
    AND fpkm_unstranded IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sample_barcode, gene_name, sample_type_name
),
joined AS (
  SELECT pa.gene_symbol, pa.sample_submitter_id, pa.sample_type,
         pa.avg_protein_log2ratio,
         LOG(r.avg_fpkm + 1) as log_fpkm_plus_1
  FROM proteome_agg pa
  JOIN rna_agg r
    ON pa.sample_submitter_id = r.sample_barcode
    AND pa.gene_symbol = r.gene_name
    AND pa.sample_type = r.sample_type_name
),
gene_corr AS (
  SELECT sample_type, gene_symbol,
         CORR(avg_protein_log2ratio, log_fpkm_plus_1) as correlation
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY sample_type, gene_symbol
)
SELECT sample_type, AVG(correlation) as avg_correlation
FROM gene_corr

WITH paad_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bcr_patient_uuid, bcr_patient_barcode
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_clinical_PANCAN_patient_with_followup`
  WHERE acronym = 'PAAD'
),
paad_mutations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode, Hugo_Symbol
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' 
    AND Hugo_Symbol IN ('KRAS', 'TP53')
    AND FILTER = 'PASS'
),
patient_status AS (
  SELECT 
    p.bcr_patient_uuid,
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_kras,
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_tp53
  FROM paad_patients p
  LEFT JOIN paad_mutations m ON p.bcr_patient_barcode = m.ParticipantBarcode
  GROUP BY p.bcr_patient_uuid
),
contingency AS (
  SELECT 
    has_kras,
    has_tp53,
    COUNT(*) as observed
  FROM patient_status
  GROUP BY has_kras, has_tp53
),
margins AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(observed) as grand_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as kras_pos,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as kras_neg,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 1 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as tp53_pos,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 0 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as tp53_neg
  FROM contingency
),
chi_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    c.observed,
    m.grand_total,
    m.kras_pos, m.kras_neg, m.tp53_pos, m.tp53_neg,
    CASE 
      WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN (m.kras_pos * m.tp53_pos) / m.grand_total
      WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 0 THEN (m.kras_pos * m.tp53_neg) / m.grand_total
      WHEN c.has_kras = 0 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN (m.kras_neg * m.tp53_pos) / m.grand_total
      ELSE (m.kras_neg * m.tp53_neg) / m.grand_total
    END as expected,
    POWER(c.observed - CASE 
      WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN (m.kras_pos * m.tp53_pos) / m.grand_total
      WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 0 THEN (m.kras_pos * m.tp53_neg) / m.grand_total
      WHEN c.has_kras = 0 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN (m.kras_neg * m.tp53_pos) / m.grand_total
      ELSE (m.kras_neg * m.tp53_neg) / m.grand_total
    END, 2) / 
    CASE 
      WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN (m.kras_pos * m.tp53_pos) / m.grand_total
      WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 0 THEN (m.kras_pos * m.tp53_neg) / m.grand_total
      WHEN c.has_kras = 0 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN (m.kras_neg * m.tp53_pos) / m.grand_total
      ELSE (m.kras_neg * m.tp53_neg) / m.grand_total
    END as chi_sq_component
  FROM contingency c, margins m
)
SELECT 
  SUM(chi_sq_component) as chi_squared_statistic
FROM chi_calc

),
chr11_gain AS (

first_txn AS (

  UNNEST(hits) as h

    AND h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date ASC, visitId ASC, h.hitNumber ASC) = 1
),
first_visit AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId

user_events AS (
  SELECT 
    fv.fullVisitorId,
    fv.first_visit_date,
    lv.last_visit_date,
    lv.last_visit_is_mobile,
    ft.first_txn_date,
    ft.first_txn_is_mobile,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(lv.last_visit_date, '00000000'), COALESCE(ft.first_txn_date, '00000000')) as last_recorded_event_date,

      AND t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
      AND t.pickup_latitude != 0 AND t.pickup_longitude != 0
      AND z.state_code = 'NY'
      AND ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
  ),
  distinct_zip_codes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT zip_code FROM jan1_trips
  ),
  all_hours AS (
    SELECT 0 AS hour UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 
    UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7
    UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11
    UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
    UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19
    UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23
  ),
  zip_hour_cross AS (
    SELECT d.zip_code, h.hour
    FROM distinct_zip_codes d
    CROSS JOIN all_hours h
  ),
  trip_counts AS (
    SELECT zip_code, hour, COUNT(*) AS trip_count
    FROM jan1_trips
    GROUP BY zip_code, hour
  ),
  base AS (
    SELECT 
      c.zip_code,
      c.hour,
      COALESCE(t.trip_count, 0) AS total_trips
    FROM zip_hour_cross c
    LEFT JOIN trip_counts t ON c.zip_code = t.zip_code AND c.hour = t.hour
  )
  SELECT zip_code, hour, total_trips FROM base
)
ORDER BY total_trips DESC
LIMIT 5
SELECT MAX(answer_count) as max_answers FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` WHERE tags LIKE '%python-2.7%' AND tags NOT LIKE '%python-3.x%'

SELECT

  a.comment_count AS answer_comment_count,

FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a

JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` q_owner ON q.owner_user_id = q_owner.id

comment_on_answer AS (

SELECT user_id, question_tags FROM comment_on_answer

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    id, title, body, tags, view_count,
    CASE 
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-layout(\||$)') THEN 'android-layout'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-activity(\||$)') THEN 'android-activity'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-intent(\||$)') THEN 'android-intent'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-edittext(\||$)') THEN 'android-edittext'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-fragments(\||$)') THEN 'android-fragments'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-recyclerview(\||$)') THEN 'android-recyclerview'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)listview(\||$)') THEN 'listview'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-actionbar(\||$)') THEN 'android-actionbar'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)google-maps(\||$)') THEN 'google-maps'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-asynctask(\||$)') THEN 'android-asynctask'
    END as tag_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
  WHERE 
    (LOWER(title) LIKE '%how%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%how%')
    AND NOT (
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%fail%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%fail%' OR
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%problem%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%problem%' OR
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%error%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%error%' OR
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%wrong%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%wrong%' OR
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%fix%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%fix%' OR
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%bug%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%bug%' OR
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%issue%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%issue%' OR
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%solve%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%solve%' OR
      LOWER(title) LIKE '%trouble%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%trouble%'
    )
    AND (
      REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-layout(\||$)') OR
      REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-activity(\||$)') OR
      REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-intent(\||$)') OR
      REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-edittext(\||$)') OR
      REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-fragments(\||$)') OR
      REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-recyclerview(\||$)') OR
      REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)listview(\||$)') OR
      REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-actionbar(\||$)') OR
      REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)google-maps(\||$)') OR
      REGEXP_CONTAINS(tags, r'(^|\|)android-asynctask(\||$)')
    )
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    tag_name,
    id,
    title,
    view_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tag_name ORDER BY view_count DESC) as rn
  FROM filtered
)
SELECT tag_name, id, title, view_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 50
ORDER BY tag_name, view_count DESC

WITH 
-- Condition 1: Question owner
question_owners AS (
  SELECT 
    pq.id AS question_id,
    pq.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pq.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq
),

-- Condition 2: Accepted answerer (only where user_id is not null)
accepted_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    pq.id AS question_id,
    pa.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pq.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa ON pq.accepted_answer_id = pa.id
  WHERE pq.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND pa.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
),

-- Condition 3: Answer score > 5 (only where user_id is not null)
high_score_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    pq.id AS question_id,
    pa.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pq.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq ON pa.parent_id = pq.id
  WHERE pa.score > 5
    AND pa.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
),

-- Condition 4: Answer score > 20% of total answer scores for that question AND score > 0
question_total_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    parent_id AS question_id,
    SUM(score) AS total_score
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
  GROUP BY parent_id
),
percent_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    pq.id AS question_id,
    pa.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pq.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq ON pa.parent_id = pq.id
  JOIN question_total_scores qts ON pq.id = qts.question_id
  WHERE pa.score > 0 
    AND pa.score > 0.2 * qts.total_score
    AND pa.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
),

-- Condition 5: Top 3 highest-scoring answers per question
ranked_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.parent_id AS question_id,
    pa.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pa.score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.parent_id ORDER BY pa.score DESC, pa.id ASC) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  WHERE pa.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
),
top3_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    question_id,
    user_id
  FROM ranked_answers
  WHERE rn <= 3
),

-- Combine all unique (user_id, question_id) pairs
all_associations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, user_id FROM question_owners WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, user_id FROM accepted_answers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, user_id FROM high_score_answers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, user_id FROM percent_answers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, user_id FROM top3_answers
),

-- Get view counts per association (deduplicated by question per user)
assoc_with_views AS (
  SELECT 
    aa.user_id,
    aa.question_id,
    pq.view_count
  FROM all_associations aa
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq ON aa.question_id = pq.id
),

-- Sum per user and rank
user_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(awv.user_id AS INT64) AS user_id,
    SUM(awv.view_count) AS total_view_count
  FROM assoc_with_views awv
  GROUP BY awv.user_id
  ORDER BY total_view_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
)

SELECT 
  ut.user_id,
  u.display_name,
  ut.total_view_count
FROM user_totals ut
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u ON ut.user_id = u.id
ORDER BY ut.total_view_count DESC

WITH user_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.id AS answer_id,
    pa.parent_id AS question_id,
    pa.creation_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  WHERE pa.owner_user_id = 1908967
    AND pa.creation_date < TIMESTAMP('2018-06-07')
),
answer_votes AS (
  SELECT 
    va.post_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN va.vote_type_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN va.vote_type_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.votes` va
  WHERE va.post_id IN (SELECT answer_id FROM user_answers)
  GROUP BY va.post_id
),
answer_tags AS (
  SELECT 
    ua.answer_id,
    pq.tags
  FROM user_answers ua
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq
    ON ua.question_id = pq.id
)
SELECT 
  tag,
  SUM(10 * upvotes + 15 * accepted) AS total_score
FROM answer_tags,
UNNEST(SPLIT(tags, '|')) AS tag
LEFT JOIN answer_votes av ON answer_tags.answer_id = av.post_id
GROUP BY tag
ORDER BY total_score DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH questions_2021 AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    creation_date,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM creation_date) AS dow_num,
    FORMAT_DATE('%A', creation_date) AS day_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
  WHERE creation_date >= '2021-01-01' AND creation_date < '2022-01-01'
),
answered_within_1hr AS (
  SELECT 
    q.id AS question_id
  FROM questions_2021 q
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
    ON q.id = a.parent_id
  WHERE TIMESTAMP_DIFF(a.creation_date, q.creation_date, SECOND) >= 0 
    AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(a.creation_date, q.creation_date, SECOND) <= 3600
  GROUP BY q.id
)
SELECT 
  q.dow_num,
  q.day_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT q.id) AS total_questions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.question_id) AS answered_within_1hr,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT a.question_id), COUNT(DISTINCT q.id)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM questions_2021 q
LEFT JOIN answered_within_1hr a
  ON q.id = a.question_id
GROUP BY q.dow_num, q.day_name
ORDER BY q.dow_num

WITH qualifying_questions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT q.id as question_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON a.parent_id = q.id
  WHERE q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL
     OR SAFE_DIVIDE(a.score, q.view_count) > 0.01
),
question_details AS (
  SELECT 
    q.id as question_id,
    LENGTH(q.body) as body_length,
    q.owner_user_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN qualifying_questions qq ON qq.question_id = q.id
),
badge_counts AS (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as badge_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.badges`
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT 
  qd.question_id,
  qd.body_length,
  u.reputation,
  (u.up_votes - u.down_votes) as net_votes,
  COALESCE(bc.badge_count, 0) as badge_count
FROM question_details qd
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u ON u.id = qd.owner_user_id
LEFT JOIN badge_counts bc ON bc.user_id = qd.owner_user_id
ORDER BY qd.body_length DESC
LIMIT 10
SELECT title FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE '%how%' AND tags LIKE '%android%' ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT 1

WITH pop_data AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    year_2017,
    year_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(year_2018 - year_2017, year_2017) * 100 AS pop_growth_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country`
  WHERE year_2017 IS NOT NULL AND year_2018 IS NOT NULL
    AND year_2017 > 0
),
health_data AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2017 THEN value END) AS val_2017,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2018 THEN value END) AS val_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population`
  WHERE indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD'
    AND year IN (2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY country_code
),
health_growth AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(val_2018 - val_2017, val_2017) * 100 AS health_growth_pct
  FROM health_data
  WHERE val_2017 IS NOT NULL AND val_2018 IS NOT NULL
    AND val_2017 > 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS country_count
FROM pop_data p
JOIN health_growth h ON p.country_code = h.country_code
WHERE p.pop_growth_pct > 1
  AND h.health_growth_pct > 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_debt_indicators

WITH latest_gdp AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.region,
    id.country_code,
    id.value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id.country_code ORDER BY id.year DESC) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.country_summary` cs
    ON id.country_code = cs.country_code
  WHERE id.indicator_code = 'NY.GDP.MKTP.KD'
    AND cs.region IS NOT NULL
    AND id.value IS NOT NULL
),
per_country AS (
  SELECT region, country_code, value
  FROM latest_gdp
  WHERE rn = 1
),
region_medians AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    APPROX_QUANTILES(value, 100)[OFFSET(50)] as median_gdp
  FROM per_country
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT region, median_gdp
FROM region_medians
ORDER BY median_gdp DESC

WITH 
overlaps AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    b.geo_id as blockgroup_id,
    b.area_land_meters as bg_area,
    ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(z.zip_code_geom, b.blockgroup_geom)) / ST_AREA(b.blockgroup_geom) as overlap_ratio
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_blockgroups.us_blockgroups_national` b
    ON ST_INTERSECTS(z.zip_code_geom, b.blockgroup_geom)
  WHERE z.state_fips_code = '08'
    AND b.state_fips_code = '08'
),
bank_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    zip_code,
    COUNT(*) as total_banks
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fdic_banks.locations`
  WHERE state = 'CO'
  GROUP BY zip_code
),
zip_concentrations AS (
  SELECT 
    o.zip_code,
    AVG(b.total_banks * o.overlap_ratio) as avg_banks_per_blockgroup
  FROM overlaps o
  JOIN bank_counts b ON o.zip_code = b.zip_code
  GROUP BY o.zip_code
)
SELECT zip_code, avg_banks_per_blockgroup
FROM zip_concentrations
ORDER BY avg_banks_per_blockgroup DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    a.geo_id,
    a.total_pop AS pop_2011,
    a.median_income AS income_2011,
    b.total_pop AS pop_2018,
    b.median_income AS income_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2011_5yr` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` b
    ON a.geo_id = b.geo_id
  WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '36047%'
    AND a.total_pop > 1000
    AND b.total_pop > 1000
),
with_increases AS (
  SELECT 
    geo_id,
    pop_2011,
    pop_2018,
    income_2011,
    income_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(pop_2018 - pop_2011, pop_2011) AS pop_pct_increase,
    income_2018 - income_2011 AS income_abs_increase
  FROM base
),
ranked_pop AS (
  SELECT geo_id, pop_pct_increase,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pop_pct_increase DESC) AS pop_rank
  FROM with_increases
),
ranked_income AS (
  SELECT geo_id, income_abs_increase,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY income_abs_increase DESC) AS income_rank
  FROM with_increases
)
SELECT 
  rp.geo_id,
  rp.pop_pct_increase,
  rp.pop_rank,
  ri.income_abs_increase,
  ri.income_rank
FROM ranked_pop rp
JOIN ranked_income ri ON rp.geo_id = ri.geo_id
WHERE rp.pop_rank <= 20
  AND ri.income_rank <= 20
ORDER BY rp.geo_id

WITH monthly_minutes AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE(end_date)) AS month_num,
    subscriber_type,
    SUM(duration_sec) / 60.0 AS total_minutes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE(end_date)) = 2017
    AND subscriber_type IN ('Customer', 'Subscriber')
  GROUP BY month_num, subscriber_type
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    month_num,
    MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN total_minutes END) AS customer_minutes,
    MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN total_minutes END) AS subscriber_minutes
  FROM monthly_minutes
  GROUP BY month_num
)
SELECT 
  month_num,
  customer_minutes,
  subscriber_minutes,
  ABS(customer_minutes - subscriber_minutes) AS abs_diff_seconds,
  ABS(customer_minutes - subscriber_minutes) / 1000.0 AS abs_diff_in_thousands
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY abs_diff_in_thousands DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE icd10_descendants AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship`

  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
),
all_icd10_concepts AS (
  SELECT ancestor_id, descendant_id FROM icd10_descendants
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT 1569798, 1569798
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT 1569765, 1569765
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT 1569777, 1569777
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT 35208655, 35208655
),
snomed_mappings AS (

  FROM all_icd10_concepts aic
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr 
    ON aic.descendant_id = cr.concept_id_1 AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
all_snomed_descendants AS (
  SELECT sm.ancestor_id, ca.descendant_concept_id
  FROM snomed_mappings sm
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor` ca 
    ON sm.snomed_concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
standard_concepts AS (
  SELECT 1569798 AS icd10_concept_id, 'L70' AS icd10_code, 'Acne' AS condition_name

with_lag AS (

max_increases AS (

user_span AS (

    num_active_months,

    (DATE_DIFF(last_month, first_month, MONTH) + 1) - num_active_months as num_gaps
  FROM user_first_last
),
user_month_spans AS (
  SELECT 
    u.user_id,
    u.first_month,
    DATE_ADD(u.first_month, INTERVAL n MONTH) as expected_month,
    DATE_DIFF(DATE_ADD(u.first_month, INTERVAL n MONTH), u.first_month, MONTH) + 1 as month_number
  FROM user_span u
  JOIN UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, DATE_DIFF(u.last_month, u.first_month, MONTH))) as n
),
user_gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    ums.user_id,

  LEFT JOIN user_months um 
    ON ums.user_id = um.user_id AND ums.expected_month = um.activity_month
  WHERE um.user_id IS NULL
),
user_max_gaps AS (

pivoted AS (

WITH 
sorafenib_targets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
  WHERE i.drugID = 157 
    AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
    AND (e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL)
    AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL)
),
all_pes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pte.pe_stable_id, pe.uniprot_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pte
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` pv ON pte.pathway_stable_id = pv.stable_id
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe ON pte.pe_stable_id = pe.stable_id
  WHERE pte.evidence_code = 'TAS' AND pv.lowest_level = TRUE
),
pathway_pe AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pte.pathway_stable_id, pte.pe_stable_id, ap.uniprot_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pte
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` pv ON pte.pathway_stable_id = pv.stable_id
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe ON pte.pe_stable_id = pe.stable_id
  JOIN all_pes ap ON pte.pe_stable_id = ap.pe_stable_id
  WHERE pte.evidence_code = 'TAS' AND pv.lowest_level = TRUE
),
pathway_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    pp.pathway_stable_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pp.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN pp.pe_stable_id END) as a,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pp.uniprot_id NOT IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN pp.pe_stable_id END) as b
  FROM pathway_pe pp
  GROUP BY pp.pathway_stable_id
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ap.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN ap.pe_stable_id END) as total_a,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ap.uniprot_id NOT IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN ap.pe_stable_id END) as total_b
  FROM all_pes ap
),
chi_sq AS (
  SELECT 
    pc.pathway_stable_id,
    pc.a as targets_in,
    pc.b as non_targets_in,
    tc.total_a - pc.a as targets_out,
    tc.total_b - pc.b as non_targets_out,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      (tc.total_a + tc.total_b + pc.a + pc.b) * 
      POWER((pc.a * (tc.total_b - pc.b)) - (pc.b * (tc.total_a - pc.a)), 2),
      (pc.a + pc.b) * ((tc.total_a - pc.a) + (tc.total_b - pc.b)) * (pc.a + (tc.total_a - pc.a)) * (pc.b + (tc.total_b - pc.b))
    ) as chi_squared
  FROM pathway_counts pc
  CROSS JOIN total_counts tc
)
SELECT 
  pv.stable_id as pathway_stable_id,
  pv.name as pathway_name,
  cs.chi_squared,
  cs.targets_in,
  cs.targets_out,
  cs.non_targets_in,
  cs.non_targets_out
FROM chi_sq cs
JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` pv ON cs.pathway_stable_id = pv.stable_id
ORDER BY cs.chi_squared DESC
LIMIT 3

    r1.standard_type,
    r1.activity_id as activity_id_1,
    r2.activity_id as activity_id_2,
    SAFE_CAST(r1.standard_value AS FLOAT64) as sv1,
    SAFE_CAST(r2.standard_value AS FLOAT64) as sv2,
    r1.standard_relation as sr1,
    r2.standard_relation as sr2,
    r1.doc_id as doc_id_1,
    r2.doc_id as doc_id_2,
    GREATEST(r1.heavy_atoms, r2.heavy_atoms) as max_heavy_atoms
  FROM rep r1
  JOIN rep r2 
    ON r1.assay_id = r2.assay_id 
    AND r1.standard_type = r2.standard_type
    AND r1.molregno < r2.molregno
),
pair_doc_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT doc_id_1 as doc_id FROM pair_data
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT DISTINCT doc_id_2 as doc_id FROM pair_data
),
pair_docs AS (
  SELECT d.doc_id, d.journal, SAFE_CAST(d.year AS INT64) as yr, SAFE_CAST(d.first_page AS INT64) as fp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29` d
  JOIN pair_doc_ids pdi ON d.doc_id = pdi.doc_id
),
doc_ranked AS (
  SELECT doc_id, journal, yr, fp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY journal, yr ORDER BY fp) as rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY journal, yr) as cnt
  FROM pair_docs
),
doc_dates AS (
  SELECT doc_id,
    COALESCE(yr, 1970) as pub_year,
    CAST(LEAST(COALESCE(FLOOR(CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN (rn - 1) * 1.0 / (cnt - 1) ELSE 0 END * 11) + 1, 12), 12) AS INT64) as pub_month,
    COALESCE(MOD(CAST(FLOOR(CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN (rn - 1) * 1.0 / (cnt - 1) ELSE 0 END * 308) AS INT64), 28) + 1, 1) as pub_day
  FROM doc_ranked
),
classified AS (
  SELECT pd.*,
    CASE 
      WHEN sv1 > sv2 THEN 'decrease'
      WHEN sv1 < sv2 THEN 'increase'
      WHEN sv1 = sv2 THEN 'no-change'
      ELSE 'unknown'
    END as change_type
  FROM pair_data pd
),
with_dates AS (
  SELECT c.*,
    dd1.pub_year as pub_year_1, dd1.pub_month as pub_month_1, dd1.pub_day as pub_day_1,
    dd2.pub_year as pub_year_2, dd2.pub_month as pub_month_2, dd2.pub_day as pub_day_2
  FROM classified c
  LEFT JOIN doc_dates dd1 ON c.doc_id_1 = dd1.doc_id
  LEFT JOIN doc_dates dd2 ON c.doc_id_2 = dd2.doc_id
),
latest AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE 
      WHEN pub_year_1 > pub_year_2 THEN CONCAT(CAST(pub_year_1 AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_month_1 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_day_1 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN pub_year_1 < pub_year_2 THEN CONCAT(CAST(pub_year_2 AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_month_2 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_day_2 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN pub_month_1 > pub_month_2 THEN CONCAT(CAST(pub_year_1 AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_month_1 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_day_1 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN pub_month_1 < pub_month_2 THEN CONCAT(CAST(pub_year_2 AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_month_2 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_day_2 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN pub_day_1 >= pub_day_2 THEN CONCAT(CAST(pub_year_1 AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_month_1 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_day_1 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      ELSE CONCAT(CAST(pub_year_2 AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_month_2 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_day_2 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
    END as latest_pub_date,
    GREATEST(doc_id_1, doc_id_2) as highest_doc_id,
    TO_HEX(MD5(TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(activity_id_1 AS A, activity_id_2 AS B)))) as mmp_delta_uuid
  FROM with_dates
)
SELECT molregno_1, molregno_2, assay_id, standard_type, max_heavy_atoms,
  latest_pub_date, highest_doc_id, change_type, mmp_delta_uuid
FROM latest
ORDER BY molregno_1, molregno_2
